verdict.rationale: llama.cpp describes itself as a "Plain C/C++ implementation without any dependencies" and documents building from source by cloning the repo and following its build guide. Community users corroborate this: one praises not needing "a billion python/c/cpp dependencies" and another successfully compiled it from source. Missing for 10: the build guide's actual steps and toolchain requirements (e.g., build system, compiler versions, optional GPU backend deps) are not detailed in the evidence.
